r1.title: Round 1
who: Every NEET-PG qualified candidate who registers, paying a non-refundable fee and a refundable security deposit.
Only clear-cut vacancies are shown in Round 1.
opts: Report with your originals and get admitted. If you don't give willingness to upgrade, you keep this seat and you're out of Round 2.

Please note that in case you are satisfied with the seat allotted to you in Round-1 and do not give willingness for up-gradation in Round-2 as 'Yes', you will not be considered eligible for participating in Round-2 i.e. for up-gradation of your choice.
Report, get admitted, and give willingness to upgrade at the college. You keep this seat unless Round 2 gives you a better one.

In case a candidate wants to ensure /retain his/her Round -1 seat and wants to upgrade his/her allotted seat, he/she should join Round-1 seat and give willingness for Up-gradation at the allotted college.
Not reporting counts as a free exit. You can take part in Round 2 without registering again.
If a candidate does not report at the allotted institute in Round-1, this will be considered as 'Free Exit' (option available only in Round-1).
You take part in Round 2 without registering again.
If a registered candidate is not allotted a seat in round one (1), he can participate in round 2 directly without fresh registration.
gaps: when a joined Round 1 candidate may resign, or what it costs (only that they "need not register again", p.36 (c)).
an explicit line that the deposit is refunded after a free exit. The forfeiture rules start at Round 2.

r2.title: Round 2
who: Registered in Round 1 but no seat; Round 1 seat-holders who gave willingness; those whose Round 1 seat was cancelled at document verification over a changed category or PwD status; free-exit candidates (log in again); new candidates who register and pay.
opts: Your Round 1 seat is cancelled at once. Take a relieving letter and join the Round 2 seat. If you don't, you lose the deposit and the Round 1 seat is already gone.

the seat allotted during the first round will be automatically cancelled immediately (and allotted to somebody else eligible as per merit) and candidate will have to join the college / seat allotted during second round. If candidate does not join the college/seat allotted during the second round, with in stipulated time, as per schedule, his/her Refundable Security Deposit will be forfeited.
Report and get admitted. To try Round 3, give willingness at the college. Join without it and you're out of Round 3.
Candidates who are holding any seat in Round-1 or Round-2 of AIQ and have not given willingness to upgrade in round 3 will not be eligible.
Exit with forfeiture: the deposit isn't refunded. You may register for Round 3 again with fresh fees.
Candidate who has been allotted a seat in Round-2 and further Round but do not report at the college may Exit with Forfeiture. (i.e. The Security Deposit will not be refunded in such a case)
You take part in Round 3 without registering again.
If a candidate freshly registered in round 2 is not allotted a seat, he/she can participate in round 3 directly without fresh registration.

r3.title: Round 3
who: New registrants; the never-allotted; those who resigned from Round 2 or exited with forfeiture (paying again); Round 1 or Round 2 seat-holders who gave willingness to upgrade.
opts: Final. You can't upgrade or resign, and you can't take part in any further round.

If a candidate joins in 3rd round, they shall not be permitted to resign from 3rd round of AIQ/Deemed/Central Universities. They will not be allowed to participate in any further rounds of Counseling after joining in Third Round of AIQ.
You lose the deposit and you're out of MCC's later rounds.
If any candidate does not join Round 3 seat, he may exit with forfeiture of security deposit and elimination (cannot participate in further rounds of counselling conducted by MCC, DGHS).
You can take part in the Stray Round.
If a candidate freshly registers in round 3 and is not allotted any seat, he/she is eligible to participate in stray/further rounds.
gaps: what exactly is paid again by those who resigned or exited with forfeiture in Round 2 (the registration fee, the deposit or both); the bulletin gives no separate amount (p.38; p.54, Q36).
whether the Supreme Court approved upgrading up to Round 3: the bulletin says NMC would seek its approval and doesn't give the outcome (p.6, 1.4).

stray.title: Stray round
who: Only candidates holding no seat anywhere (AIQ, state or deemed), or who didn't take part in Rounds 1-3.
Not those allotted in Round 3 who didn't join.
opts: The bulletin's flow chart says that once you join, you can't resign. The chart is marked as for representation only, and the round's rules on p.39 don't repeat the line.
Joins the Seat at college (once joined, candidate cannot resign)
If a candidate is allotted a seat in Stray round, he/she has to report & join the allotted seat at college/institute else there will be forfeiture of security deposit.

after.title: Leaving the course
gaps: any bond or penalty for leaving an all-India, deemed, central or DNB seat, other than losing the security deposit when you surrender a seat allotted in Round 2 or later (2.6, p.9). The bulletin states a bond only for armed-forces (AFMS) seats (pp.78-89). Check the rules of the state and the college that hold the seat; for fees, bonds and service, the bulletin sends candidates to the college (2.9, p.10; p.55, Q49).

r3: After its Round 3, MCC shares the data of its joined candidates with the states, which remove those all-India joiners before processing their own Round 3. The bulletin doesn't say whether that list holds only Round 3 joiners or everyone who has joined by then.

MCC of DGHS will share the data of joined candidates in round 3 of counselling with all the participating States. States will weed out the data of AIQ joined candidates before seat processing of Round-3 of state counselling.
The states share everyone who joined up to their Round 3, and MCC removes them before the all-India Stray Round.
Candidates who have joined upto round 3 of state counselling will be filtered and weeded out before processing of Stray Round of AIQ counselling.
stray: Anyone MCC allots in its Stray Round is removed before the states run theirs.
The data of candidates who have been allotted in Stray round by MCC will be filtered and weeded out before processing of Stray Round of states by state counselling authorities.

reg: AIQ: Rs 1,000 (UR/EWS), Rs 500 (reserved). Deemed: Rs 5,000. Non-refundable. Applying for both: pay only the deemed fee. No separate row for central institutes or DNB.
dep: AIQ: Rs 25,000 (UR/EWS), Rs 10,000 (reserved). Deemed: Rs 2,00,000. Applying for both: pay only the deemed deposit.
lose: From Round 2: an allotted seat you don't join, or surrender. In any round: an admission cancelled (wrong information, missing documents).
back: After all rounds end, to the account you paid from, without interest.
leave: Not in the bulletin, except armed-forces (AFMS) seats, which carry a bond. Check the state's and the college's rules.
